description:

Launch Date: Matic was launched in April 2019 at a price of $0.004.

asr.full_text: Here's some steps you need to know to buy Wazaba. Open your Trust wallet and make sure you have the Matich tokens ready. Click on Discover button. Click on it and drag the referral link into the search. Choose Matich Network and select it. Click on the Connect. Click here to connect your wallet. Choose investment amount. Here you can invest any amount of Maticch tokens. The minimum investment is 0.01 Maticch. Approve pop-up message. We are investing with 0.01 Maticch. Then you will receive a pop-up message to approve. Click on it. Deposit successfully completed. Your deposit is now successfully completed. View your dashboard. You can now see your dashboard displaying your MATIC deposit amount, token holdings, token locks, holding value, direct referrals, total team members, and the ranks you've achieved. You can also view details such as Direct Deposit, Team Deposit, Level Income, Level Achiever, VIP Income, Pool Income, Total Income and Total Withdrawals. Everything will be shown on your dashboard. Copy referral link. You can copy your referral link from here and earn referral income by inviting friends to join. View Contract Address. Here, you can open the contract address to see how many people are joining the smart contract. You can also view all transactions here. Thank you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Wazaba Network as an investment opportunity, claims viewers can earn unlimited Matic and potentially very large referral income, and urges them to invest immediately. It gives step-by-step instructions to connect Trust Wallet, deposit at least 0.01 Matic, and join through a referral link, directing cryptocurrency into the promoted network. The presentation is promotional rather than reporting, testing, or criticizing the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central walkthrough directs viewers to invest MATIC in Wazaba tokens. The description promotes that purchase with a claim that Wazaba's future value could reach or exceed MATIC's value. The dashboard's team and level-income fields, together with the invitation to earn referral income, separately support a recruitment-income mechanism.
